build_standard_roi_head: build a StandardRoIHead instance with bbox and mask heads for object detection and instance segmentation
train_forward_standard_roi_head: run forward_train on StandardRoIHead with image features, proposals, and ground truth bboxes to compute losses
test_simple_standard_roi_head: test StandardRoIHead with simple_test using image features and proposals to get detection results
test_aug_standard_roi_head: test StandardRoIHead with aug_test using augmented image features and proposals for test-time augmentation
init_weights_standard_roi_head: initialize StandardRoIHead weights with optional pretrained model path for shared head, bbox, and mask components
